articles.headline: France vs. Iraq delayed amid thunderstorms in Philadelphia
articles.description: The match between France and Iraq in Philadelphia was delayed for an hour due to thunderstorms in the area.

articles.headline: England coach Tuchel wary of disturbing 'the music' at World Cup
articles.description: Thomas Tuchel said his plan to ensure England's attacking players continue to thrive at the World Cup is to "not disturb the music" when they take on Ghana.

articles.headline: World Cup Daily: Mbappé brace for France, Norway-Senegal also underway
articles.description: It's another week of 2026 FIFA World Cup action, and we have some big teams playing today, including Argentina, France and Norway.

articles.headline: Lionel Messi breaks record for most World Cup goals with Austria double
articles.description: Lionel Messi became the highest goal scorer in men's World Cup history Monday, moving up to 18 with a superb double in Argentina's Group J match against Austria.

articles.headline: Lionel Messi 'angry' about penalty miss before brace, sealing World Cup goalscoring record
articles.description: Lionel Messi said he was "very angry" after missing a penalty despite making World Cup history as Argentina sealed their place in the Round of 32 with a 2-0 win over Austria.

articles.headline: Why every round-of-32 team will, won't win FIFA World Cup
articles.description: Then there were 32. Or we're getting there, anyway. So, let's review why each team still alive at the 2026 World Cup could win the whole thing -- and why each probably won't.
